opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (or up to £750 for Adelphi co-sponsored) (Scheme B); up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members: Scheme A – undergraduate, Masters and PhD students and postdoctoral scientists within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C – PhD students and postdoctoral scientists within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based members (or non‑UK members attending UK conferences) and must present a poster or talk.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of junior scientist members at genetics‑related conferences (Society meetings, other meetings, or virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members can apply provided they are studying or working in the UK, or the course is held in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisors must be Society members. Members must have been Society members for at least one year (unless students).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to attend formal short training courses or collaborative visits to other labs for genetics/genomics techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members can apply if they are studying or working in the UK, or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and accommodation costs for field‑based genetic research projects that aim for results suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: up to several thousand pounds (e.g., £1,000–£2,000) depending on scope

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any Genetics Society member who wishes to organise a genetics‑themed meeting not directly run by the Society. Applications may be submitted at any time, preferably at least three months before the event.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship for genetics‑themed meetings (one‑off events) including travel, accommodation and a Carer’s Award component.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs (UK‑based travel only).

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Groups wishing to run regular series of genetics meetings may apply. Applications should be submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
opportunities.summary: Funding to sponsor regular meetings of a new Special Interest Group in genetics, covering speaker travel, accommodation, publicity and other direct meeting costs.
